  • Constructor Details

    • WellResult

      private WellResult(String nodeId, FieldNetworkTopology.Service service, FieldWellNetworkCoupler.WellStatus status, double nodePressureBara, double targetRateKgS, double appliedRateKgS, double rateResidualKgS, boolean innerConverged, double innerPressureResidualBar, int innerIterations, String message)
      Create one immutable well result.
      Parameters:
      nodeId - canonical well node
      service - production or injection service
      status - operating classification
      nodePressureBara - solved well-node pressure in bara
      targetRateKgS - live well target mass rate in kg/s
      appliedRateKgS - rate applied to network mass balance in kg/s
      rateResidualKgS - absolute target/applied rate residual in kg/s
      innerConverged - true when the inner well contract is satisfied
      innerPressureResidualBar - signed WellSystem IPR/VLP pressure residual in bar, or zero for direct WellFlow
      innerIterations - WellSystem iterations, or one for direct WellFlow
      message - diagnostic message
